claims.evidence: No weight or capacity marking is visible in Photo 0 or Photo 1; only the handwritten 'MX' is shown.
No brand, model, or country-of-origin marking is visible in the photos, so origin cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: Cylinder may be empty rather than full
risks.proof: Photo of the cylinder on a weighing scale or a clip showing gas content/weight.

risks.risk: No visible certification or expiry date
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the collar or foot ring showing stamped certification and expiry dates.

risks.risk: No evidence of pressure testing or recertification
risks.proof: Photo of the recertification or test-date stamp on the cylinder body.

risks.risk: Valve may not function or may leak
risks.proof: Video clip of the valve being opened and closed with a leak test at the outlet, such as soapy water.
risks.if_unproven: priced as valve faulty or leaking

proof_requests: Close-up of any weight or capacity marking on the cylinder
Close-up of certification or expiry date stamping
Photo of recertification or test date stamp
Video of valve operation and leak test
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a gas cylinder, so it can be priced at its worst case; the seller's 12kg and foreign claims are not shown in the photos and do not prevent a worst-case price.
